name: workfromphone
description: Phone-first Codex work with compact delivery, resilient recovery, and authorization-aware approvals.

interface.shortDescription: Finish Codex work remotely from your phone.
interface.longDescription: Keep Codex tasks usable when your phone is the only interface. Codex handles workstation actions autonomously, reuses project runbooks and authenticated browser state, avoids assigning desktop chores, delivers files and images through mobile-reachable channels, keeps image batches compact-safe, avoids redundant confirmation for unchanged explicitly authorized actions, and recovers safely from compaction, disconnections, timeouts, and uncertain retries.
defaultPrompt: Use $workfromphone to finish this task while I am away from my computer.
Use $workfromphone and deliver every output in a phone-friendly format.
Use $workfromphone to continue autonomously with compact progress updates.
